# `agents/retrospective.ts`

## Overview

The `retrospective` module provides functionality for running automated weekly retrospective analyses over completed tasks. It constructs prompts for Claude, parses structured responses, and applies proposed learning changes—including creating, reinforcing, or contradicting learnings—before updating the last-run timestamp in configuration.

---

## Interfaces

### `RetrospectiveReport`

Represents the structured output of a retrospective analysis.

```typescript
interface RetrospectiveReport {
  summary: string;
  metrics: {
    totalTasks: number;
    firstPassRate: number;
    reworkRate: number;
    failureRate: number;
    totalCostUsd: number;
  };
  topLearnings: { id: number; content: string; reinforcements: number }[];
  decayingLearnings: { id: number; content: string; confidence: number }[];
  blindSpots: string[];
  proposals: {
    action: "create" | "promote" | "deprecate";
    scope: string | null;
    category: string | null;
    content: string | null;
    tags: string[] | null;
    targetId: number | null;
  }[];
  costInsights: string;
}
```

**Members:**

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `summary` | `string` | High-level narrative summary of the retrospective period. |
| `metrics` | `object` | Aggregate task performance statistics for the period. |
| `metrics.totalTasks` | `number` | Total number of tasks completed during the period. |
| `metrics.firstPassRate` | `number` | Rate of tasks completed successfully on the first attempt. |
| `metrics.reworkRate` | `number` | Rate of tasks that required rework. |
| `metrics.failureRate` | `number` | Rate of tasks that resulted in failure. |
| `metrics.totalCostUsd` | `number` | Total cost incurred during the period, in USD. |
| `topLearnings` | `{ id: number; content: string; reinforcements: number }[]` | Learnings with the highest reinforcement counts. |
| `decayingLearnings` | `{ id: number; content: string; confidence: number }[]` | Learnings whose confidence has fallen and may need review. |
| `blindSpots` | `string[]` | Identified gaps or recurring problem areas. |
| `proposals` | `object[]` | Proposed changes to the learning store to be applied. |
| `proposals[].action` | `"create" \| "promote" \| "deprecate"` | The action to take on the target learning. |
| `proposals[].scope` | `string \| null` | Optional scope context for the proposal. |
| `proposals[].category` | `string \| null` | Optional category for the proposal. |
| `proposals[].content` | `string \| null` | Content of the new or updated learning, if applicable. |
| `proposals[].tags` | `string[] \| null` | Tags to associate with the learning, if applicable. |
| `proposals[].targetId` | `number \| null` | ID of an existing learning to target, if applicable. |
| `costInsights` | `string` | Narrative analysis of cost patterns and recommendations. |

### `runRetrospective`

Runs a weekly retrospective analysis over completed tasks since the last run. Gathers task outcomes, costs, and learning data; sends to Claude for analysis; applies proposed changes (create/reinforce/contradict learnings); and updates the `lastRetrospectiveRun` config timestamp.

```typescript
import { runRetrospective } from '...'

async function runRetrospective(): Promise<RetrospectiveReport>
```

**Parameters:** None

**Returns:** `Promise<RetrospectiveReport>` — Resolves with the full retrospective report after all proposals have been applied.

**Example:**

```typescript
import { runRetrospective } from './agents/retrospective';

const report = await runRetrospective();

console.log(report.summary);
console.log(`Tasks completed: ${report.metrics.totalTasks}`);
console.log(`First-pass rate: ${report.metrics.firstPassRate}`);
console.log(`Total cost: $${report.metrics.totalCostUsd.toFixed(2)}`);

for (const proposal of report.proposals) {
  console.log(`[${proposal.action}] targetId=${proposal.targetId} — ${proposal.content}`);
}
```
